atoms.b:
• ((European_colonists)) build trade networks and settlements
• ((enslaved_Africans)) are brought across the Atlantic and forced to work

• ((westward)) expansion requires ((workers)) for industry and agriculture,
immigrants from Asia and Europe fill these jobs
• populations in ((new_territories)) or colonies become citizens or colonial subjects

• 1950s: immigration from Europe ((slows_down)); immigration from Asia, Africa and Latin America ((rises))
• 2000s: 9/11 shifts the US perspective on immigration, leading to ((strict_regulation))
• 2020s: ICE enforces ((deportation)) more strongly than before, anti-immigrant sentiment is at an all-time high

b: ++Immigration refers to resettlement into a certain area.
++Immigration can refer to different forms of migration.

++Forced migration describes resettlement because of dangerous circumstances.
